create.softgags: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS softgags (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, userid TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, date INT(11) NOT NULL, active TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1')
create.mutes: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mutes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, guid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL UNIQUE, userid TEXT NOT NULL, date INT(11) NOT NULL, expiration INT(11) NOT NULL, active TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1')
